request.description:
POST [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobId}/accept/{providerId}](http://localhost:8080/jobs/{jobId}/accept/{providerId})

Headers:  
Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}

Expected Response: 200 OK  
{  
"applicationId": 123,  
"jobId": 1,  
"jobTitle": "Fix Kitchen Sink",  
"provider": {  
"userId": 5,  
"name": "John Provider",  
"email": "[provider@example.com](https://mailto:provider@example.com)",  
"phone": "+96170123456",  
"location": {...},  
"profilePhotoUrl": "...",  
"averageRating": 4.5,  
"totalReviews": 10,  
"totalJobsCompleted": 15,  
"isVerified": true  
},  
"quotedPrice": 85.00,  
"availability": "Available this weekend",  
"message": "I have 10 years experience with plumbing",  
"status": "ACCEPTED",  
"appliedAt": "2025-12-20T10:30:00",  
"updatedAt": "2025-12-21T14:25:00",  
"photoUrls": \["url1.jpg", "url2.jpg"\]  
}

---

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1/accept/999](http://localhost:8080/jobs/1/accept/999)

Headers:  
Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}

Expected Response: 400 Bad Request  
{  
"error": "Bad Request",  
"message": "Application not found for job 1 and provider 999",  
"timestamp": "2025-12-21T14:25:00"  
}

---

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1/accept/5](http://localhost:8080/jobs/1/accept/5)

Headers:  
Authorization: Bearer {{different_customer_token}}

Expected Response: 400 Bad Request  
{  
"error": "Bad Request",  
"message": "Only the job owner can accept applications. You do not own job ID 1",  
"timestamp": "2025-12-21T14:25:00"  
}

---

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1/accept/7](http://localhost:8080/jobs/1/accept/7)

Headers:  
Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}

Expected Response: 400 Bad Request  
{  
"error": "Bad Request",  
"message": "Cannot accept application. Job status is IN_REVIEW but must be OPEN. Job ID: 1",  
"timestamp": "2025-12-21T14:25:00"  
}

---

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1/accept/5](http://localhost:8080/jobs/1/accept/5)

Headers:  
Authorization: Bearer {{provider_token}}

Expected Response: 403 Forbidden  
(If you have role-based authorization)  
OR  
400 Bad Request with "Only the job owner can accept applications"

---

GET [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobId}/applications](http://localhost:8080/jobs/1/applications)

Headers:  
Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}

Expected Response: 200 OK  
\[  
{  
"applicationId": 123,  
"providerId": 5,  
"status": "ACCEPTED",  
...  
},  
{  
"applicationId": 124,  
"providerId": 7,  
"status": "REJECTED", // ← Auto-rejected  
...  
}  
\]

---
